title: quizinfra quiz data — version 1 (legacy)
description: The original, unversioned export format. Files from this era carry NO schemaVersion field; the stamp is therefore optional (and pinned to 1 so a v1 file stamped by hand still validates). TYPE-STRICT, PRESENCE-LENIENT policy: every field may be absent — the import pipeline's normalize stage fills documented defaults — but any field that IS present must match its declared type exactly. Arrays carry no cardinality constraint (the four-option editor layout is a UI policy, not a data-model one) and unknown properties are ignored (dropped at normalization). Pre-release policy amendments (2026-11): presence, cardinality and unknown-property rules were relaxed before anything shipped, which rule 1's pre-release exception allows; the file is frozen from here on. FROZEN: never edit; introduce a new version directory instead.
